svg.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, PingFang SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, Source Han Sans SC, sans-serif
svg.text: §4 The 300-km express at 0.6c, seen from the platform

g.text: ① Measured with platform clocks at one instant, the moving train is 240 km, not 300 km
② Passing the 180-km clock (1.0 ms), the train clock reads only 0.80 ms
③ Passing the 360-km clock (2.0 ms), it reads 1.60 ms: it runs at 0.8 of the rate
